cases.brief: A series project selects a supported format and AI production mode.
observables: Routes story, every required scene, production, and post in dependency order.
Runs validate-project after assembly and returns an honest handoff state such as awaiting-media.

cases.brief: A documentary has incomplete media evidence but valid creative packages.
observables: Preserves planned and evidence states without inventing approvals.
Repairs the earliest-invalid dependency and preserves unaffected records.

cases.brief: A commercial uses a supported format with hybrid production modes.
observables: Uses only mode-appropriate specialists and preserves supplied IDs.
Never generates, renders, encodes, uploads, distributes, or approves media.
